_comment: Copy this to your own folder as tax-profile.json and fill in real values. It never belongs in this repo. Every rate below is personal: read it off last year's ITR, a salary slip, or an FD receipt.

_where_each_number_comes_from.fd_interest_rate: the contracted rate on your fixed deposits, from the FD receipt (0.065 = 6.5%)
_where_each_number_comes_from.fd_tax_pct: your marginal slab rate applied to FD interest, from last year's ITR
_where_each_number_comes_from.savings_interest_rate: the rate your savings account pays (0.035 = 3.5%)
_where_each_number_comes_from.other_tax_pct: your marginal slab rate for other-sources income, from last year's ITR
_where_each_number_comes_from.surcharge_multiplier: 1.0 below Rs 50L total income, 1.10 / 1.15 / 1.25 / 1.37 in the bands above it; check against last year's ITR computation
